text: Imagine thinking your ten-leg parlay is a good bet.
Each leg, the book keeps about four and a half percent.
Your real odds of hitting all ten: one in one thousand twenty-four. They pay you about six hundred forty-three times your money.
A fair price would be one thousand twenty-four.
So where did the other three hundred eighty-one go? Their pocket.
Most legs you've ever hit? Be honest. Comment.
Follow for more math they hate.
